content_blocks.title: The central idea
content_blocks.text: Dimensionality reduction compresses features or produces lower-dimensional representations for analysis, training, or visualization. A plot that looks separated can distort distances and should not be treated as proof of distinct real-world groups.

items.title: Principal component analysis
items.text: Dimensionality reduction maps many features into a smaller representation, often for compression or visualization. Preserved variance or visible groups do not guarantee that task-relevant information is retained.
